content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a question about displaying text on the [product_name] TDE. The values from counters and other sources are left-aligned, but I would prefer them to be right-aligned as seen in [product_name] Soft Comfort. Additionally, some values show a '+' sign in front of them. You can refer to the attached image. Does anyone know why this happens or how to fix it?

Unfortunately, you can't change this setting. This is a limitation that came with the [product_name] [article_no] series. Analog numeric values are always left-aligned, instead of right-aligned as preferred. Also, a '+' sign is always shown for positive numbers by default.

analysis.insight_summary: Feedback indicates that the [product_name] TDE interface does not allow changing text alignment or removing the '+' sign for positive values. These restrictions make data presentation inconsistent with other related software and limit user ability to format displays as desired.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the ability to customize alignment (such as right-aligning values) and to control the formatting, so that displays match the formatting options available in other [company_name] tools.
